item: #23 (seeded move-order tie-break noise channel) — Phase 0 probe only
commit: 41a82e2 (plan13 final; the Phase-0 instrumentation is temporary and reverted — `git diff --exit-code` verified clean before and after)
probe: temporary env-gated counters (ATOMIC_TIE_PROBE=1) in `sort_moves` (src/search/dfpn/history.rs), recording per call: move count, top tie-group size of the composite score, total moves in tie-groups, whether the top-2 tie, plus a top-tie-size histogram; module deleted after the measurement
probe_runs: quick benchmark suite (dec01-dec46 + m23-m29 from tests/fixtures) plus m22_white and m20_white, each as `atomic_solver --fen <FEN> --tt-size 128 --first-outcome --outcome-only --budget 20000000 --timeout 120` under ATOMIC_TIE_PROBE=1; up to 3 concurrent processes
hygiene_arm: dec15 and dec10 at the plan12 1 B budget, probe disabled and enabled, must reproduce the plan12 salt-0 child-eval counts exactly

kill_gate.rule: pre-registered in plan14.md D4: proceed to productization only if the fraction of `sort_moves` calls with a top-2 tie is >= 10% on >= 2 of the four gate cases (m22_white, m20_white, dec13, dec10)
kill_gate.verdict: H0 fires (needs >= 2): the tie-break channel has no decision-relevant ties to break on the eval-sensitive cases; item #23 closes measured-out before Phase 1 (no product knob, no rollout)

notes: Raw probe transcripts (*.out, *.err under RAW=/tmp/plan14/probe) are not committed per the AGENTS.md measurement layout; the committed probe_driver.py regenerates them deterministically.
Hygiene arm passed: dec15 1,077,420 and dec10 4,262,128 child evals, identical to the plan12 salt-0 values, with the probe both disabled and enabled (the probe never perturbs the trajectory).

The eval-sensitive cases have the LOWEST top-2 tie rates (dec13 1.05%, dec14 1.75%, m22 1.54%): where the salt channel was constrained by basin structure, tie-breaking is silent as well. Deep tie mass is large (tied_moves 33-81% of all moves per call) but sits away from the top of the ordering.

m20_white was censored at the 20 M probe budget (as expected; its full first-outcome solve needs 0.8-2 B evals). Its top-2 tie rate over the first 1,008,426 sort_moves calls is the gate maximum (6.19%) and still far below the threshold.
